body:
Closes #386 (reopened: a re-recorded 4x2 variant failed from non-lucky seeds; the P0 sharpening ladder from #387 was witness-fitted to the frozen variant and did not certify the moved needle, joint near-miss 8.2e-3).

The general bridge, replacing witness-fitted machinery with the mechanism the class actually needs: `anchorRotationScan` in the `solveJointBest` tail (gate: recovered-start violation <= 0.1). Rotate the entire best shape by d (preserves every dF tie exactly; wrap edge cases self-veto through the exact violation), coarse d in [-45, 45] at 0.25 deg with 0.02/0.002 refinement; per d the start derives closed-form via `bestTranslate` (pin to the tightest constraint), a direct solve returns when the byte-exact violation reaches zero, and a pinned-CF certify sits behind a ratcheting bar (init 0.02, lowered to each attempted v) so deep-but-uncertifiable near-misses (j346, tail rv 8.6e-4) cannot burn certify storms. Skipped when absolute F pins exist.

Measured: the new witness pair solves from all probed seeds bit-identically (obj 6525.854408, better than the lucky-seed path's 6525.8452; the failing file lands directly in the coarse pass at d=1.25). New pins `gh386-4x2b-seedshift` / `gh386-4x2b-luckyseed`; all prior gh386 pins stay green. Sweep 104/104 with zero per-capture outcome changes at 33.0 s (+0.3 s vs pre-scan), in-box seed-parity screen clean, `:core:check -PslowTests` green.

**Addendum (third witness variant): the failure was a hard crash, not a solver-quality gap.** `LongRunSolver.sliceConstraints` kept facing (dF) constraints at the window-end tick; facing arrays are length n against the positions' n+1, so a seam dF constraint in a sliced window threw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in `JumpConstraintCompiler.evaluate` whenever the window SLP survived phase 1, and three layers of silent catches (race arm, per-node GraphRunner, B&B futures) turned the crash into a clean-looking 93 ms miss with the free machinery never running. Fixed at the root (the slicer caps Mode.F ticks at the window's last input; the seam constraint is enforced by the successor window, so semantics are preserved) and all three catch sites now print full stacks (B&B keeps expected timeouts quiet). The third variant pair solves from all probed seeds with the objective identical to the lucky file (6525.826886) and is pinned as `gh386-4x2c-*`; all prior gh386 pins stay green; sweep 104/104 with zero per-capture outcome changes; in-box parity screen clean; `:core:check -PslowTests` green.
title: fix(solver): bridge free-start near-misses with an anchor rotation scan
